previousHero.purpose: Illustrative BOXANH brand visual; not actual business proof
previousHero.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original website hero photo for BOXANH, illustrative brand visual
Primary request: create one polished photorealistic editorial lifestyle photograph in landscape 3:2, showing two Vietnamese university-age adults moving into a bright, modest modern rented studio. They are naturally smiling during the activity, unposed, carrying practical stackable dark emerald green reusable plastic moving crates with lids. One small stack of books and a pothos plant are visible; include a small warm orange accent object.
Scene/backdrop: uncluttered sunlit cream wall, blue-grey doorway, a simple tidy studio interior. Genuine everyday Vietnamese student lifestyle, warm and approachable.
Composition/framing: waist-up to three-quarter-body candid medium-wide composition; main people and crates centered so the photo can be cropped on the right side of a landing page. Keep both faces comfortably inside the central 60 percent, keep breathing room around them. No embedded graphics or UI.
Lighting/mood: warm natural daylight, premium commercial photographic quality with realistic skin texture, gentle editorial color grading, calm optimistic mood.
Materials/textures: visibly reusable rigid plastic emerald crates with realistic lids and handles, real cotton clothing, natural plants and book edges.
Constraints: faces and bodies anatomically natural; exactly two adult people; no logos, no readable text, no watermark; no cardboard-dominated scene; no exaggerated posing; no duplicated hands, no extra limbs. Image only.
